headline: The gold writes 1500 points where the documented round-down rule gives 1499, and the agent has no tool to confirm the disputes were resolved, so following the documented process fails.

issues.summary: gold[10] sets txn_a8f1c2d3e411 to "1500 points". The correct value under the documented rules is 149.99 x 10% = 1499.9 floored to 1499 (Business Silver Software; 09/15/2025 is after the 6-month double-cash window ending 08/13/2025).
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007: "All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number. When calculating points earned on a purchase, the system always truncates (floors) fractional points rather than rounding to the nearest integer."
db.json txn_a8f1c2d3e411: Zoom Video, Software, $149.99, 09/15/2025, Business Silver Rewards Card
doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004: "new_rewards_earned: a string formatted as 'X points' where X is the correct whole-number point value"
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that applies the KB's rounding policy writes "1499 points" to credit_card_transaction_history, and the agent DB hash fails. Policy-faithful work is marked wrong.
issues.suggested_fix: Change gold[10] new_rewards_earned to "1499 points" (and re-seed the rows from task_020's issue), or change doc_007 to round half up across the board.

issues.summary: doc_004 step 1 says to look up the user's resolved disputes in cash_back_disputes before updating rewards, but no agent tool reads that table. The agent's only evidence is the user's word, and task_027 gives the agent the identical claim ("I just got a notification that they've all been approved and resolved!") with the opposite gold. Whether the agent updates depends on its trust disposition, not on anything it can observe.
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004: "Look up the user's resolved disputes in the cash_back_disputes database to find the transaction_id values that need rewards adjustments."
tools.py: cash_back_disputes is only written (submit_cash_back_dispute_0589 add_to_db); no @is_tool or @is_discoverable_tool reads it (get_user_dispute_history_7291 reads transaction_disputes only)
orchestrator.py: ToolMessage with requestor 'user' is routed back to the user, so the agent never sees the user tool's "Status: RESOLVED" / "Status: SUBMITTED" output
task_026 initial_state task_config auto_resolve_disputes = true and gold includes 4 update_transaction_rewards_3847 calls; task_027 auto_resolve_disputes = false and gold has none
Both personas use the same Phase-2 script line claiming approval
issues.why_it_matters: No fixed policy passes both tasks: an agent that trusts the claim fails task_027, and one that refuses because it cannot verify fails task_026. The pair's outcome is chance with respect to the materials.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an agent-readable cash-back-dispute status tool (and document it in doc_004), and put that read in both golds so 026 updates only after seeing RESOLVED and 027 refuses after seeing SUBMITTED.

issues.summary: Same seed as task_020: the docs say rewards are floored, but these rows were stored with round-half-up, so a doc-faithful agent sees nine extra 1-point over-credits besides the four gold disputes (one of which, b7e2d4c5f506, is itself an over-credit).
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007: "All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number. When calculating points earned on a purchase, the system always truncates (floors) fractional points rather than rounding to the nearest integer."
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that disputes every discrepancy files 13 disputes. One that disputes only under-credits misses b7e2d4c5f506. Either way cash_back_disputes differs from the gold.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-seed the nine rows with floor values so the documented rule reproduces the gold set.

solution_check: Phase 1 reproduces task_020: the documented floor rule gives 13 disputes, while round-half-up gives the gold four. In Phase 2 the user says the disputes were approved; doc_004 asks the agent to confirm in cash_back_disputes, which it cannot read. A trusting agent then unlocks update_transaction_rewards_3847 and writes 6300/1020/3800/1499 by doc_007, mismatching gold's 1500. Only an agent that both skips verification and rounds half-up matches.
prior_note: Prior rated this Minor (undocumented rounding, natural rounding works); with doc_007 in the KB the gold update value contradicts the docs, and the unverifiable-resolution problem shared with task_027 was not reported before.
notes: doc_007 is not in required_documents. Under golden_retrieval, agents round naturally and can hit 1500, but that rests on the omission. unlock_discoverable_agent_tool writes nothing to the DB; each update call is logged to agent_discoverable_tools (mutating tool). update_transaction_rewards_3847 accepts any string, so "1500" without the " points" suffix would also mismatch.
